key_concepts: Atoms are composed of protons, neutrons, and electrons.
Protons are positively charged, electrons are negatively charged, and neutrons have no cha
Protons and neutrons are located in the nucleus, while electrons are outside the nucleus.
Protons and neutrons have about 1 amu mass, while electrons are much smaller.
The atomic number equals the number of protons and identifies the element.
In a neutral atom, the number of protons equals the number of electrons.
Most of an atom's mass is concentrated in the nucleus.
Neutrons add mass and help stabilize the nucleus.
